section_title: Private banking and wealth management risks > Special purpose vehicle risks

propositions.proposition: SPVs can have complex and opaque structures to disguise the true beneficial ownership.
source_quotes: can have complex and opaque structures to disguise

propositions.proposition: The presence of red flags such as complex ownership structures, lack of transparency, or unclear purpose of the SPV indicates attempts to disguise illicit funds or conduct fraudulent activities using SPVs.
source_quotes: red flags that indicate attempts to disguise

propositions.proposition: PIVs can be used in Ponzi schemes and insider trading.
source_quotes: can be used in Ponzi schemes and insider trading

propositions.proposition: Financial institutions must be vigilant in conducting enhanced due diligence (EDD) on SPVs and PIVs.
source_quotes: must be vigilant in conducting enhanced due diligence (EDD) on SPVs and PIVs

propositions.proposition: Financial institutions should ensure that investments in SPVs and PIVs comply with CDD regulations such as the Financial Crime Enforcement Network's CDD rule.
source_quotes: It is important to ensure these investments comply with CDD regulations

propositions.proposition: Financial institutions must identify ultimate beneficial owners and understand the true purpose of these entities.
source_quotes: must identify ultimate beneficial owners and understand the true purpose

propositions.proposition: Identifying ultimate beneficial owners and understanding the true purpose of SPVs/PIVs helps mitigate potential financial crime risks.
source_quotes: This will help mitigate any potential financial crime risks
